rule: External discovery/features sources are supplemental only. They do not make a coin COMPLETE or replace our own verified launch transaction and raw 10-minute transaction archive.

2026-11-01.coverage_note: Known recorder gap 04:42-05:33 UTC; hundreds of launches may be absent.

daily_feature_files.note: Daily feature files for all five target days were listed in the dataset; features are sampled non-randomly, and null means not sampled, not zero.

quality_rules: Use only rows with decoder_complete=1 for buy-derived features and rug-related outcomes.
Split classic and mayhem launches; mayhem outcomes are materially different.
Filter quote_asset=sol for SOL-denominated comparisons; other quote assets must not be interpreted as SOL.
Treat f10_* and f60_* nulls as not sampled, never as zero.
Do not use outcome or post-launch columns as entry-time features; keep them as labels only.
Coverage is not a complete independent census; the documented November 1 gap must remain explicit.
sources.limitation: This source has launch-level outcomes and sampled early-life features, not the full raw transaction-by-transaction 10-minute history required by our primary archive.

The free daily endpoint exposes only the last three UTC days. It is useful for Nov 23 discovery but does not supply the earlier Nov 1-22 raw trade history. Launch metadata and first-10-second bundle fields are not substitutes for our own transaction observations.
